brief_title: Evaluating Anti-Obesity Medications 6 Months After Metabolic Surgery
official_title: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Single-Center Study of Efsubaglutide Alfa in Patients Remaining Obese 6 Months After Metabolic Surgery

lead_sponsor.name: The Affiliated Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital of Nanjing University Medical School

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in %TWL from baseline to endpoint

brief_summary: This clinical trial aims to evaluate the weight-loss efficacy and safety of efsubaglutide alfa in patients who remain obese 6 months after metabolic surgery.

inclusion.text: Voluntarily sign the informed consent form and agree to strictly adhere to the requirements and restrictions outlined in the informed consent form and this protocol throughout the entire study period.

exclusion.text: Subjects suspected by the investigator of having a potential allergy to the study drug or its components, or those with a history of allergic constitution;
sub_items: Use of any of the following drugs or treatments prior to screening:

exclusion.text: ● Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1R) agonists within 3 months prior to screening
● Use within 3 months prior to screening of any weight-affecting medications, including systemic corticosteroids, metformin, sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors, etc.;
● Use of weight-affecting herbal supplements, health products, or meal replacements within 3 months prior to screening;
sub_items: Use of weight-loss medications within 3 months prior to screening or currently using such medications, e.g., sibutramine hydrochloride, orlistat, phentermine, etc.;
Participation in other clinical trials (receiving investigational drug treatment) within 3 months prior to screening.

exclusion.text: History of depression; or history of severe psychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, etc.;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: Uncontrolled hypertension at screening despite at least 4 weeks of antihypertensive medication, defined as systolic blood pressure >160 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure >100 mmHg;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening
③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: History of cardiac disease at screening: acute myocardial infarction, unstable angina, post-coronary artery bypass grafting, post-percutaneous coronary intervention, severe arrhythmia;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: Hemorrhagic or ischemic stroke, or transient ischemic attack within 6 months prior to screening;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: History or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma, multiple endocrine neoplasia (MEN) type 2A or 2B at screening;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: History of acute or chronic pancreatitis, or pancreatic injury at screening;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: Presence of limb deformities or amputations preventing accurate measurement of height, weight, or other anthropometric parameters;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: Major or moderate surgery, severe trauma, or severe infection within 1 month prior to screening, deemed unsuitable for study participation by the investigator;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: History of suicidal tendencies or suicide attempts;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: Anticipated surgery during the study period;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: Participants testing positive for HIV antibodies, hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), hepatitis C virus (HCV) antibodies, or syphilis antibodies at screening;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening

exclusion.text: History of alcohol abuse within 1 month prior to screening, defined as average weekly alcohol intake exceeding 21 units for males or 14 units for females; ④ Presents clinically significant abnormalities on 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) at screening: - Second- or third-degree atrioventricular block - Long QT syndrome or QTcF > 450 ms - PR interval < 120 ms or PR interval > 220 ms - QRS > 120 ms QRS duration >120ms, left or right bundle branch block, Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome, or other severe arrhythmias requiring treatment;
exclusion.group: ③ History or evidence of any of the following conditions prior to screening
sub_items: History of other risk factors for torsades de pointes, such as hypokalemia at screening, family history of long QT syndrome, or concomitant use of QT/QTc-prolonging medications at screening; ⑥ Blood donation volume and/or blood loss ≥400 mL within 3 months prior to screening, or hemoglobin <110 g/L (males) or <100 g/L (females); ⑦ Presence of any other factors deemed by the investigator to potentially affect the efficacy or safety evaluation of this study, rendering the subject unsuitable for participation.
